text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Did Gran-chan finally break through the wall?
Her tandem run with Bubble-san looked pretty solid, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
""An Umamusume finally conquering three different divisions...!?
I'm definitely going to the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in person!""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just what I'd expect from Gran-chan...!
Even through hardships... she won't give up...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I've come back having become someone
worthy of battling against you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As promised, let's meet
at the grandest stage of all!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...What does it mean to be the strongest Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That debate had been brought to the table time and again,
with all kinds of "strongest" theories being argued...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Being the "strongest at the mile," like Gran-chan says,
is just one of those things.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I cannot afford to lose.
I must demonstrate the royal standard of strength...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—A bouquet of victory.
This time for sure, I want to deliver it...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's why—
I can't give it to you, Gran-san...

—And then came the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
The day of Gran Alegria's greatest ambition had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...The cheers are reaching all the way out here!
Isn't that about 3.5 miles louder than usual?
choice_data_list: Master was in the stands too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
!
—Then I must show you what the strongest run looks like.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Our dream: conquering all three divisions. And passing down Master's teachings.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Without a victory in today's race, it will never come to pass!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I will definitely win!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you, Gran-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Heheh, me too! I've been wanting to run with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want Gran-san's dream to come true, I really do.
However—that day is not today.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Many milers have tried and failed to achieve the Three-Tier Sweep... And today, I will stop it once again...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This victory is the one thing I cannot give up!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'll conquer all three distance categories, just watch me!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (...All right, it's the big moment. This time, even the smallest mistake won't be tolerated.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Deeeep breath in...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (I'll run my strongest and go for the win!)
